subject.title: feat(slack): allow configurable App Home views

question: Should OpenClaw support a durable `channels.slack.appHome.view` configuration contract for operator-authored Slack App Home content?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally narrow and lives in the Slack plugin, but adding a new documented configuration surface is a product and support commitment that tests cannot decide.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow Slack setting
options.body: Accept the inline-only configuration contract once the contributor supplies redacted live Slack publication and reload proof.

options.title: Keep the built-in Home view only
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and preserve the existing fixed safe Home view.

options.title: Request a different extension boundary
options.body: Ask for a maintained plugin-level or other owner-approved customization mechanism before adding a core-documented config key.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow Slack setting
recommendation.body: Accept the inline-only configuration contract once the contributor supplies redacted live Slack publication and reload proof.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository-level product decision is required for a new public configuration contract.
